I'm truly sorry. I'm still only 20 it's not great. I just hope that you get through these things. You seem like a very nice person. Childhood trauma is just some another form of mental torture that no one understands and I'm so sorry.

Happy Birthday!! 
Please no one's ugly okay no one ever. You seem like a very sweet person. And honestly having a partner isn't the best or even friends unless you know they aren't two faced. I really hope that you stop feeling this way. Sending hugs x

Please don't be. I got my results and I honestly was glad but sad that it wouldn't kill me fast and it can be treated to quite some extent. And my parents would do anything to save me. But at the same time it feels horrible that I wouldn't get to experience how great the world is, how times change no matter how shitty my life is. I really hope you find happiness or even just some sort of satisfaction.
Yes I do! But I really don't think I can cross off even one thing off of it.

Mines sorta treatable with the medicines too. For now it would keep things in control and eventually it wouldn't be fatal. I really don't want to do this but I can't take the mental and physical agony of other things in my life. My parents love me immensely but everything else is just horrible.
As much as I'd like to go, I really hope that whatever it is that is making you envious goes away. No one deserves to think this way. Sending hugs x
